text: The Cauldron is Eva's connection to The Vast One. Tossing ingrediants in summons the power of The Vast One pulling in your entire stockpile of that resource! It does however require at least two types of resources, for flavour reasons. Once you toss ingredients in you will recieve an amount of stew based on the rarity and count of the resources you selected. You then taste the stew to draw from the well of The Vast One's power. You will receive cards based on Eva's level which affects her weights as displayed on the Cauldron screen. Each card has a tier from 1-8 and levels up at the following thresholds. For now there are no additional bonuses for collecting beyond the cap of that tier but you can continue for as long as you like. Perhaps more power will come from this in the future? The following thresholds are currently implemented. Each category except for the buff category will additionally tier up as you pass the threshold with all cards in it. If all cards are Tier 2 or higher then the category will be Tier 2. Each Tier you complete in this fashion will award 0.1% Alter Echo Power.
